**A bomb explodes outside the offices of Greece's main railway company [[Hellenic Train]] in [[Athens]], [[Greece]]. No casualties were reported. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/suspected-bomb-strikes-near-offices-of-greek-railway-company-in-athens/ (CTV News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
** [[China–United States trade war]]
***[[China]] increases its tariffs on U.S. imports from 84% to 125% in response to U.S. duties on Chinese goods of 145%. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-increase-tariffs-us-goods-125-up-84-finance-ministry-says-2025-04-11/ (Reuters)]
***China states that it will not respond to any further U.S. tariff increases, as U.S. goods have already been priced out of the Chinese market by existing tariffs, but may still impose other economic measures. [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/04/11/china-strikes-back-with-125percent-tariffs-on-us-goods-starting-april-12.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*More than 100 people have died in the past three days after unseasonably heavy rain floods parts of [[India]] and [[Nepal]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1903518/over-100-people-killed-after-heavy-rain-hits-india-nepal (Dawn)]
*A boat smuggling immigrants capsized off [[St. Lucie Inlet]] in [[Florida]]. Four people are rescued by the [[United States Coast Guard]] while five others are killed. [https://www.wpbf.com/article/florida-martin-county-sheriffs-office-holds-press-conference-after-drownings/64478225 (WPBF)]
*A [[Cessna 310]] crashes into [[Interstate 95]] near [[Boca Raton Airport]] in [[Boca Raton, Florida|Boca Raton]], [[Florida]], United States, killing all three occupants of the plane and injuring one other on the ground. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/small-plane-crashes-boca-raton-airport-florida-rcna200854 (NBC News)] [https://bocanewsnow.com/2025/04/11/plane-crashes-in-boca-raton-two-reported-dead/ (Boca News Now)]
*Three people are killed when a [[Mooney M20]] crashes in the [[Cherokee National Forest]] near [[Reliance, Tennessee|Reliance]], [[Tennessee]], United States. The [[Federal Aviation Authority]] and [[National Transportation Safety Board]] are currently investigating the crash. [https://www.local3news.com/local-news/update-three-people-dead-following-plane-crash-in-cherokee-national-forest/article_bca57b6c-e6fb-4e84-afc4-5fd51d66ef31.html (WRCB)]

**An agreement is signed by top security officials from [[Panama]] and the U.S. allowing U.S. military personnel to deploy to Panama-controlled facilities. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250411-panama-deal-allows-us-to-deploy-troops-to-canal (France24)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**The U.S. president's special envoy [[Steve Witkoff]] meets with Russian president [[Vladimir Putin]] to discuss settlement options for the [[Russo-Ukrainian war]] and a potential meeting between [[Donald Trump]] and Putin. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/steve-witkoff-trump-envoy-in-russia-kremlin/ (CBS News)]
*[[Immigration policy of the second Donald Trump administration]]
**The U.S. terminates the [[temporary protected status]] of [[Afghans|Afghan]] and [[Cameroonians|Cameroonian]] nationals. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgeng08qe7zo (BBC)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Illegal immigration to the United States]]
**Twenty-six-year-old Yaquelin Dominguez-Nieves is sentenced to seven and a half years imprisonment for her part in a [[people smuggling]] operation that killed 16 and injured two [[Cuba]]n [[Illegal immigration|undocumented migrants]] in a [[shipwreck]] in [[South Florida]], United States, on November 16, 2024. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/cuban-woman-gets-7-12-years-in-prison-for-human-smuggling-conspiracy-that-led-to-16-deaths/ (CTV News)]
*[[Immigration to Italy]]
**The [[Italian government]] sends 40 [[asylum seeker]]s to an [[internment|internment camp]] in [[Albania]] after their [[right of asylum|asylum applications]] were rejected, preparing them to be [[deportation|deported]]. [[Human migration|Migrants]] can be held for a maximum of 18 months under [[Law of Italy|Italian law]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/italy-sends-40-rejected-asylum-seekers-to-albania/a-72225909 (DW)]
* [[Capital punishment in the United States]]
**American [[spree killer]] [[Mikal Mahdi]], who killed three people, including an off-duty [[police officer]], in July 2004, is [[Execution by firing squad|executed by firing squad]] at the [[Broad River Correctional Institution]] in [[Columbia, South Carolina]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/south-carolina-firing-squad-mikal-mahdi-rcna200963 (NBC News)]
